name: Manual escape-hatch "Link existing PR" form in PullRequestSection
testIds: PullRequestSection > renders the Link existing PR control for a review-status item with no PR yet, when onLinkPr is provided
PullRequestSection > does not render the Link existing PR control when onLinkPr is omitted, even in review status
PullRequestSection > does not render the Link existing PR control when the item is pr_pending (already has a PR)
PullRequestSection > keeps the Link existing PR submit disabled until both a URL and a valid PR number are entered
PullRequestSection > calls onLinkPr with the URL and parsed number, then resets the form on success
PullRequestSection > surfaces the server's rejection message on failure (e.g. wrong status) instead of silently succeeding
backlog-manual-override > linking an existing PR associates it with a review-status item, no live session required
